Description: Project name to use as a table prefix (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens only)
Base name for the DynamoDB table (account ID, environment, and region will be appended)
Deployment environment: devl, stag, prod
Optional CI suffix to append to the table name
Billing mode: PAY_PER_REQUEST (on-demand) or PROVISIONED (capacity-based)
Read capacity units - only used if BillingMode is PROVISIONED (1-40000)
Write capacity units - only used if BillingMode is PROVISIONED (1-40000)
Name of the partition key attribute (1-255 chars)
Partition key data type: S (String), N (Number), B (Binary)
Optional sort key attribute name (leave empty for no sort key)
Sort key data type: S (String), N (Number), B (Binary)
Enable DynamoDB Streams: true or false
Stream information: KEYS_ONLY, NEW_IMAGE, OLD_IMAGE, or NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
Enable point-in-time recovery: true or false
Enable Time-to-Live (TTL): true or false
Attribute name to use for TTL (only used if EnableTTL is true)
Enable Local Secondary Index 1: true or false (requires sort key on base table)
Sort key attribute name for LSI1 (only used if LSI1Enabled is true)
Data type for LSI1 sort key: S (String), N (Number), B (Binary)
Enable Global Secondary Index 1: true or false
Partition key attribute name for GSI1 (only used if GSI1Enabled is true)
Data type for GSI1 partition key: S (String), N (Number), B (Binary)
Optional sort key attribute name for GSI1 (leave empty if not needed)
Data type for GSI1 sort key: S (String), N (Number), B (Binary)
Read capacity for GSI1 - only used if BillingMode is PROVISIONED (1-40000)
Write capacity for GSI1 - only used if BillingMode is PROVISIONED (1-40000)
